name: mustard-girl-retro-street
image_purpose: Street-fashion social post and boutique lifestyle portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a retro casual street-fashion portrait of an approved adult woman taking a relaxed pause outside a vintage boutique.
prompt.main_subject: One approved adult woman with short medium-brown bob hair, patterned floral headband, natural vintage-touch makeup, and a soft confident smile. She wears a relaxed mustard-yellow short-sleeve T-shirt with small minimal chest text, loose straight dark-brown pants, brown-and-white retro sneakers, zigzag crossbody bag, and silver ring.
prompt.composition_elements: Medium-full vertical seated portrait, cross-legged on a painted teal bench with head resting on one hand. Layer the foreground subject, shop-window reflection, vintage bicycle, skis, woven bags, and boutique interior objects. Preserve any existing storefront lettering only as reference context, without inventing new text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft even natural daylight from front-side, minimal diffused shadows, warm-cool moderate contrast, window reflections adding depth, retro street atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm standard focal-length look, deep focus across most layers, high overall sharpness, realistic fabric, wood, glass, and bicycle texture, subtle warm film grading and grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A warm retro casual street-fashion portrait of one approved adult woman with a short medium-brown bob, patterned floral headband, natural vintage-touch makeup, and a soft confident smile, seated cross-legged on a painted teal bench with her head resting on one hand. She wears a relaxed mustard-yellow short-sleeve T-shirt with small minimal chest text, loose straight dark-brown pants, brown-and-white retro sneakers, a brown-and-beige zigzag crossbody bag, and silver ring. Vintage boutique storefront with shop-window reflections, bicycle, skis, woven bags, layered interior objects, soft even natural daylight, moderate warm-cool palette of mustard, brown, teal, white, beige, and green, 50mm look, deep layered focus, realistic texture, subtle film grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, distorted hands, extra fingers, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, invented storefront text, watermark, random logos, celebrity likeness, low resolution, blur

assets.name: mustard-girl-retro-street.jpg
assets.usage: Use for approved adult subject, outfit, headband, bag, bench, boutique window, bicycle, skis, reflections, and layered composition.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve approved adult identity, exact outfit and accessories, seated pose, boutique environment, layered objects, and warm retro palette. The reference is replaceable with another approved adult boutique portrait while retaining the same nostalgic street logic. Explicitly define replacement identity, outfit, product, logo, environment, or typography; do not invent storefront text or logos.
